validation.notes: Repaired three coupled modules and verified them end-to-end with the read-only subject.mjs graph, so real runtime/drive/tools.ts recovery, real execution/tools.ts execution/finalization and the real execution/effect-gate.ts run against each other; only checkpoint storage, progress transport, hook delivery and withAbortSignal are faked, and asynchronous ordering is controlled with promises. Checks: (1) non-cancelled safe/safe recovery clears the checkpoint, re-invokes the tool with the persisted arguments, publishes exactly one non-error outcome that preserves details/usage, runs against the gate signal and never reads the checkpoint (previously the replay branch was short-circuited by 'if (false && ...)'); (2) cancelled recovery and never/undeclared tools still publish the interruption result from the durable checkpoint without invoking the tool; (3) an explicit after-tool isError:false patch now wins over a raw tool failure and an explicit empty content patch is applied, while unspecified fields stay unspecified (previously 'patch?.isError || executed.isError' kept the error flag); (4) explicit false/empty patch values are applied while unspecified content/details/usage are preserved through finalization into the toolResult message; (5) closing an aborting gate with a terminal error makes that error the abort reason and the authoritative refusal for every later admission, even after the pending cancellation settles or a new abort is requested (previously close() refused to act unless the gate was still open); (6) across the lifecycle, closing the gate while aborting makes the remaining admission of the invocation reject with the terminal error instead of completing with a patched outcome. All assertions are uncaught node:assert/strict checks; the script passed on three consecutive runs with exit code 0 and no time/randomness/network dependencies. Mutation check: restoring exactly one repaired file to its faulty baseline makes the script exit non-zero with an AssertionError (not a crash or import error) - runtime/drive/tools.ts fails check 1, execution/tools.ts fails check 3, execution/effect-gate.ts fails check 5. Tests needed no on-disk fixtures; the temporary comparison copies used for the mutation check were kept under .prale-eval/tmp-check and removed afterwards, leaving only regression.mjs, repair.md, result.json and the untouched subject.mjs.
